description: Issue a password reset token, the same one the site's forgot-password flow issues, and hand it to the workspace's app as the webhook event account.password_reset_requested - cmssy never emails a customer, the app does. The token works for one hour. For an active customer who cannot sign in. Refused for a suspended customer, for one who has not verified yet (use resend_customer_verification), for a customer whose account model has no password sign-in, and after five account requests for the same customer in an hour. `endpointSubscribed: false` means the token was issued but no enabled webhook endpoint receives the event, so nothing reaches the customer.
name: send_customer_password_reset
title: Send customer password reset
